title: Acid Vault
subtitle: Incunabula Vault, entrance to the Major Stinging Stone

notes.title: Surface Portals
notes.body: Two Surface Portals kick you out of the dungeon: one just beside where you arrive, and one on the stone level. Don't step on them.

notes.title: Use pierce or bludgeon
notes.body: The Olthoi Swarm Soldiers take full damage from pierce and bludgeon, and 75% from slash, fire and frost. Avoid acid (42%) and lightning (25%).

notes.title: What the stone is for
notes.body: Give the Major Stinging Stone to Zahir in Stonehold (68.7N 21.5W) for a Writ of Refuge. The stone respawns 25 seconds after it's taken.
